title: ai/access.json
description: The library folders the owner opened to AI and the folders left out of search. The app writes it whole (written to a temporary name, then renamed over the old file) when the session is saved; the MCP server reads it on every call. A missing file, a file that is not JSON, or a field that is not an array reads as no libraries and nothing excluded.

libraries.description: The ticked library folders that are in the library now, in the library's order.

path.description: Absolute path of the folder as the app has it.

excluded.description: Folders left out of search and backlinks (the settings' searchExclude, normalised: absolute paths, each once ignoring letter case and separators, at most 200).

absolute.description: A drive path (C:\ or C:/), a network share (\\server), or a POSIX root (/Users), at most 1024 characters.
